description: Nihal Ranjith Weerawarna v. Hubert Walter Tschope Nihal Ranjith Weerawarna v. Hubert Walter Tschope View More before Hon. Anil Gooneratne, J.
parties: Nihal Ranjith Weerawarna v. Hubert Walter Tschope Nihal Ranjith Weerawarna v. Hubert Walter Tschope View More
keywords: The Appellant challenged the District Court’s judgment granting the Respondent possession under a 99-year lease, arguing prescription, non-payment under the lease, and misdescription of the property. Held - Section 6 rather than Section 4 of the Prescription Ordinance applied; evidence supported the Respondent’s payments and identification of the property. Appeal dismissed with costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
